question: Do the fixed recruitment-ligand observations establish a useful reproducible EMC comparison after complete source, method and value review?
approach: Independent original-source replay of 704 samples by 13 RNA genes and 42 samples by 13 array probes, plus original GPL mapping; fixed covariate/comparator and ligand-component diagnostics declared after initial results; complete 12-vector source and 9,490-control calibration replay; focused reading of final additional-array, TLS public coverage, amendments and the 49-file owner freeze. No new source search or panel selection.
finding: The measured initial conditional RNA/array coefficients are reproducible, but the current evidence does not establish a new publication-worthy EMC contribution. Endorse shelving the standalone recruitment-ligand balance paper. This is a scientific-value decision, not evidence of absent ligand expression or no immune biology.
positive_observations_preserved: RNA full-model coefficient 0.764 with owner bootstrap CI 0.106–1.474; array 1.070 with CI 0.352–2.325. Nine primary RNA specimens without recorded MDB overlap retain a positive descriptive full-model coefficient. All 12 libraries completed and variable-control cross-sample Spearman median 0.9769528221 is strong.
interpretation_changing_limits: Largest RNA unadjusted contrastA0.587 is weak; full-model estimate depends on joint content adjustment. RNA against LGFMS alone has wide interval including0. Exact historical MDB linkage to GSE24369 donors is unproved.

Positive balance has different components across cohorts: adjusted RNA myeloid+0.207/T−0.558 versus array+1.364/T+0.294. It cannot be described as a reproduced absolute myeloid-ligand increase or measured immune recruitment.

Additional GSE24369 LGFMS/MFS/SFT tumour comparators give adjustedCI−0.0196–2.0859; the MFS comparison changes direction with wide uncertainty. Source SFT behavior is unspecified, corrected by amendment09 without changing membership/statistics.

All4 GSE28866 EMC conditions have an uncertain fixed closest-comparator ligand contrastA0.694,p0.330, sensitive to peak aggregation. Missing retained CD3G is not zero; a complete content-adjusted fit remains unfinished. Additional comparison outputs were read at finalfreeze; their underlying3SEQsource was not independently reprocessed in this peer review.

All12 exact-probe counts and source hashes/read accounting pass. Si05/Si09/Si10 miss the frozen within-library0.90 benchmark;9 others meet it and the0.97695cross-sample profile benchmark passes. This concerns the chosen allocation estimator, not validity of TempO or all possible mapping methods. No masked ligand observations were interpreted.

Only9490 of9500 released control rows enter calibration:4 fixed targets are masked and6 numeric source gene labels are unmatched, with no alias/date/zero imputation. Nine fixed target genes omitted from the published matrix remain missing observations.

Source-protocol-aware complete target mapping, older-array/probe/platform and native-culture contexts, eligible immune case/condition maps and generic-resource identities remain pending. TLS2026public219-case/126-RNA grouped evidence does not expose per-EMC measurements; individual data are explicitly restricted, not pending public analysis.
value_even_if_mapping_improves: A future valid method may recover target measurements in the12EMC-only libraries. That alone cannot supply independent histology controls, remove the model/comparator dependence, reconcile the different ligand components or establish cell source. Current comparative evidence and prior published immune context do not support a useful standalone disease mechanism or validated clinical result. More robust independent comparisons and complete relevant public coverage would be needed.
correction_and_recheck: Requested source-faithful wording for the broader 28 array comparators. Authoritative amendment 09 specifies 17 LGFMS, six MFS and five SFT tumor comparators, with SFT behavior unspecified; original numerical outputs are preserved. Verified all 49 final owner bindings and all 12 vector/calibration records after this amendment. No further analysis expansion.
coverage_and_portability: Endorse finalCOVERAGE/DECISION with explicit pending relevant public evidence, unavailable/restricted evidence and no exhaustion. Owner raw sources and12vectors are cache-only, not Git exports; hashes/canonical array-content hashes and rehydration instructions are inPORTABILITY. Our review does not copy them or claim they are portable source files.
strongest_alternative: Bulk immune/stromal admixture and covariate, platform, probe capture, pseudocount, histology or condition differences explain the conditional balance; no proven artefact or biological null is asserted.
reopening: An informative robust EMC comparison with complete source-faithful relevant measurements, suitable controls and donor/condition handling; proper target allocation and independent scientific-value review. Direct compartment measurements are needed if claiming ligand cell source, protein or recruitment.
restrictions: No manuscript, publication, outreach, private/UI access, target ranking, root edits or push. No interrupted FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA review reopened. TMEM266 remains shelved.
